definitions.explanation: The original painting, drawing, or artwork from which reproductions are made.
In anime production, the main drawings that define the start and end points of a movement, from which in-between frames are created.

notes:
Composed of {原|げん} (original) + {画|が} (picture/drawing). Has two distinct domains of use.

SENSE 1 — ART:
The original painting or drawing from which reproductions are made.
- {原画|げんが}⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧: original artwork exhibition
- {原画|げんが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhibit original artwork

SENSE 2 — ANIME/ANIMATION:
Key frames that define the start and end points of a movement.
- {原画|げんが}マン: key animator (well-known job title)
- {原画|げんが} → ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: key frames → in-between frames (standard workflow)
- ⟦{作画|さくが}→作画：11613_sakuga⟧: drawing/animation work (broader term)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: in-between animation frames; also "video" in modern everyday usage
